args.root_cause: `build_discount_receipt` in library/discounts.py uses a mutable default argument, `lines: list[str] = []`. Python evaluates that default once, at function definition time, so every call that omits `lines` appends to the same list object. Receipt lines from earlier orders accumulate across calls for the life of the process, which explains both the stale SAVE10 line on an order with no discount and why the problem grows the longer the server runs (and why a restart "fixes" it). The fix is to default to `None` and create a fresh list inside the function when it is not supplied.
